metadata.description:
Professional voice-over channel strip for REAPER JSFX.
Chain: Trim -> Smart Input -> Cleanup -> Expander -> De-esser -> Tape Glue -> 1175 -> LA2 -> MajorTom -> Brown Guard -> VoiceSat Limiter -> Output Safety.
Includes optional Tape Glue adapted from ZP Master Pro, multiple saturation models, stage meters, input/output meters, and voice-over focused defaults.
REAPER build: hides host sliders in GUI mode using slider_show().

Professional voice-over channel strip for ySFX-compatible hosts.
Same DSP as Pro Voice Chain, but avoids REAPER-only slider_show() calls for ySFX compatibility.
